mapper.select: SELECT NOTI_SEQ AS noti_seq, NOTI_TYPE_CD AS noti_type_cd, TITLE AS title, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(CONTENT, 4000, 1) AS content, TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_dt, TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_dt, NVL(PIN_YN, 'N') AS pin_yn, NVL(POPUP_YN, 'N') AS popup_yn, NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') AS use_yn, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at FROM ADM_NOTI_MST WHERE NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(POPUP_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND (START_DT IS NULL OR START_DT <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (END_DT IS NULL OR END_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ORDER BY NVL(PIN_YN, 'N') DESC, NVL(START_DT, DATE '1900-01-01') DESC, NOTI_SEQ DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT NOTI_SEQ AS noti_seq, NOTI_TYPE_CD AS noti_type_cd, TITLE AS title, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(CONTENT, 4000, 1) AS content, TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_dt, TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_dt, NVL(PIN_YN, 'N') AS pin_yn, NVL(POPUP_YN, 'N') AS popup_yn, NVL(VIEW_CNT, 0) AS view_cnt, NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') AS use_yn, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at, UPDATED_BY AS updated_by, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, CREATED_BY AS created_by FROM ADM_NOTI_MST WHERE NOTI_SEQ = #{notiSeq}

SELECT ADM_NOTI_MST_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ADM_NOTI_MST ( NOTI_SEQ, NOTI_TYPE_CD, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DT, END_DT, PIN_YN, POPUP_YN, VIEW_CNT, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{noti_seq}, #{noti_type_cd}, #{title}, #{content}, CASE WHEN #{start_dt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{start_dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, CASE WHEN #{end_dt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{end_dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, NVL(#{pin_yn}, 'N'), NVL(#{popup_yn}, 'N'), 0, NVL(#{use_yn}, 'Y'), SYSTIMESTAMP, #{created_by}, NULL, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE ADM_NOTI_MST SET NOTI_TYPE_CD = #{noti_type_cd}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_DT = CASE WHEN #{start_dt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{start_dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, END_DT = CASE WHEN #{end_dt} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{end_dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, PIN_YN = NVL(#{pin_yn}, 'N'), POPUP_YN = NVL(#{popup_yn}, 'N'), USE_YN = NVL(#{use_yn}, 'Y'), UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updated_by} WHERE NOTI_SEQ = #{noti_seq}
